name: of porcelain, mirrors, and unbeating flesh
source:
Wanted by all and cherished by none, Aria is the perfect pretty girl. With only a doll to the list of loved ones, Aria sets out to right the wrongs of the flesh. A life of porcelain is hollow, it seems.

[From [url=https://kryouma.itch.io/opmauf]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
所有人都想要却没人珍惜的阿丽亚是一个完美的漂亮女孩。阿丽亚的亲人名单上只有一个洋娃娃，她开始纠正肉体的错误。瓷器的一生似乎是空洞的。

[来自[url=https://kryouma.itch.io/opmauf]itch.io[/url]]
